scope: toy index calculus over F_{q^4}, q in {13,101}, 32 curves with full 2-torsion and cofactor h <= 16 (Amendment A1); exact counts, no timing; research/lift_dense_conjugate_pair_cost_20261106
statement: With an all-lift conjugate-pair line as Gaudry-Diem m=4 factor base, relations per decomposition trial are 36.6x (q=13) and 35.8x (q=101) those of the standard line F_q on the same curves and targets, about 2x the (k_conj/k_std)^4 lift-density prediction; median trials to a full-rank system are 11.5x and 17.2x fewer, with about 2x the columns; the conjugate-pair base recovers the secret on 32/32 curves.
